meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话压缩成交接文档,让下一个智能体顺利接手。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在多个智能体之间接力完成任务。
copy.tagline_en: Compress the conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hand off context between agents in a multi-step task.

howto.what: 把当前对话压缩成一份交接文档,保存到系统临时目录(不是当前工作区),供新 agent 接手。文档含「建议调用的技能」一节,引用已有产物路径而不复制内容,并抹除密钥、密码等敏感信息。
howto.when: 当你要把当前工作交给新会话或另一个 agent 接手时,手动调用它。它关闭了模型自动触发,不会被 Claude 自行启用。

say.note: 它会问你下个会话要做什么

say.text: 生成交接文档,下一个会话要接着修登录 bug
say.note: 文档会按这个重点来写

say.text: 交接文档里引用已有计划,别复制内容
say.note: 它会用路径引用已有产物

howto.what_en: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff document saved to your OS temp directory, not the workspace, so a fresh agent can continue. It includes a suggested-skills section, references existing artifacts by path, and redacts secrets.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to hand the current work to a fresh session or another agent; it's invoked manually, since model auto-invocation is disabled.

say_en.text: Write a handoff document for me
say_en.note: It will ask what the next session is for.

say_en.text: Create a handoff doc; next session fixes the login bug
say_en.note: The doc is tailored to that focus.

say_en.text: In the handoff, reference existing plans by path
say_en.note: It links to artifacts instead of copying them.
